name: Repeatable GLiNER2.5-Decide ONNX export and golden generation
logic_name: Pinned exporter inputs, memory-gated outputs, and model-derived golden provenance

test_list.description: The pipeline cannot silently export a different checkpoint or non-span architecture.
Configuration must declare exactly the pinned exporter, deterministic generator, and Python reference tools.
Any edited upstream exporter or golden script blocks operation until reviewed and re-pinned.
Exports refuse insufficient free RAM and never overwrite existing outputs.
A partial upstream output tree cannot be published as a completed export.
Only the actual 200-row deterministic generator output and matching Python reference rows can be published.
Text is normalized by appending a period only when its final character is not period, exclamation mark, or question mark.
Manifests contain SHA-256 and byte lengths of real files, and path escapes are refused.

dependencies: local Hugging Face snapshot and Python environment

inputs.name: checkpoint
inputs.description: Pinned cached span checkpoint; no network fallback is permitted.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Exporter, deterministic synthetic input generator, and Python model reference must exactly match recorded bytes.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Fresh directory only; export also requires at least 10 GiB free RAM.

output_type: PROVENANCE.json plus model fragments or Python goldens
output_description: Hashes and records exact checkpoint files, tool bytes/revision, runtime versions, generated artifacts, and normalization semantics.
